title: Priority Orchestra: Signal-flow for Key Account Intake and Escalation Playbook
creator: Ayesha Patel
description:
Objective: Design and pilot a deterministic, auditable intake and escalation signal-flow ("Priority Orchestra") that converts incoming VIP signals into roadmap lanes, short-term SLAs, and automatic operational fallbacks. This ticket defines the score composition, routing rules, integration touchpoints (Salesforce/Support, Account Execs, Console signals), and a lightweight automation prototype to accelerate decisioning for Top Accounts.

Background: We received inconsistent intake from account teams and support escalations. Work ends up in different queues with manual adjudication and missed SLAs. Existing related projects (signal-weighted admission, VIP fastpass) created one-off playbooks but no centralized automated routing service. Priority Orchestra aims to unify signals, reduce manual triage, and guarantee a clear feedback loop to customers and Internal Velocity metrics.

Goals:
- Produce a reproducible scoring function combining deal size, renewal risk, severity, product fit, and exec advocacy.
- Automate initial routing to roadmap lanes (Fast-Track / Standard / Backlog) and generate Linear tickets with templated context and suggested SLA.
- Surface a Console dashboard showing queue health and committed SLAs for top 50 accounts.
- Trial automation for 8 weeks with 10 pilot accounts and measure time-to-decision reduction and SLA adherence.
acceptance_criteria:
1) Scoring function documented and versioned in Confluence with test vectors.
2) Webhook + scoring service prototype deployed to staging that accepts simulated input and produces routing suggestions.
3) Linear automation creates tickets with correct labels and suggested SLA in >95% of pilot cases.
4) Console dashboard shows real-time counts and SLA burn-down for pilot cohort.
5) Playbook and operator runbook published; executive review completed and sign-off obtained.
scope:
In-scope: scoring schema, routing automation prototype, Linear ticket templates, Console dashboard filters for pilot accounts, communication templates for AEs and CS.
Out-of-scope: full org rollout, contract-level entitlement enforcement, billing changes, deep integration into Dedicated capacity reservation (follow-on project).
proposed_solution:
Create a modular pipeline: (1) Intake connectors (Salesforce, Support, manual form) -> (2) Signal aggregator -> (3) Priority Scorer (weights: ARR, renewal risk, incident severity, exec advocacy, performance impact) -> (4) Routing engine (maps score bands to lanes + suggested SLAs) -> (5) Linear + Slack automation + Console tagging.
Implementation notes: Scorer runs as a lightweight service (Python/Flask) with a YAML-configurable weight table so PMs can iterate without deploys. Routing engine supports manual override and 'quarantine' mode where suspect signals require human review. Include immutable audit log for every decision.
tasks: Design scoring schema and weight justification (PM + Sales data) - Ayesha
Build intake adapter for Support & Salesforce webhook payloads - ENG
Prototype scoring service and expose API - ENG
Linear automation: template and auto-create tickets with labels and SLA - Growth/PM
Console dashboard: pilot filters and SLA burn-down visualization - Analytics
Pilot run coordination with 10 accounts and AE owners - PM / CSM
Collect evaluation metrics and iterate weights after week 2 and week 6
metrics: % of routing decisions accepted without human override
Reduction in manual triage hours per week
risks: Overweighting exec advocacy could bias roadmap decisions; mitigation: include explicit cap and require renewal-risk anchor
False positives where signals originate from noisy sources; mitigation: quarantine mode and threshold tuning
Operational burden if automation creates low-value tickets; mitigation: pilot with 10 accounts and weekly review
Data privacy: ensure intake adapters redact PII before creating Linear tickets
timeline: Week 0-2: finalize schema and intake adapters. Week 3-4: scoring service + Linear automation prototype. Week 5: Console dashboard and pilot onboarding. Week 6-13: Pilot run and iterative tuning. Week 14: Review & decision to scale or sunset.
communication_plan: Weekly pilot notes to GTM leadership, daily Slack channel (#priority-orchestra-pilot) alerts for new VIP tickets, and a Confluence runbook for operators. Post-pilot review presentation to Execs and stakeholders.
